SELECT c.capability_code AS capabilityCode, c.name AS capabilityName, c.description AS description, c.category AS category, c.keywords AS keywords,
tc.tool_id AS toolId, tc.tool_version AS toolVersion, tc.tool_name AS toolName, tc.priority AS priority
FROM ya_capability c
INNER JOIN ya_tool_capability tc ON tc.capability_code = c.capability_code
INNER JOIN ya_tool t ON t.tool_id = tc.tool_id
INNER JOIN ya_tool_version tv ON tv.tool_id = tc.tool_id AND tv.version = tc.tool_version
INNER JOIN ya_tenant_installation ti ON ti.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ti.tool_id = tc.tool_id AND ti.version = tc.tool_version
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ti.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY tc.priority ASC
